category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Policy and regulations regarding the physical operating environment for organizational assets are met.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-1 (Physical and Environmental Protection Policy), PE-3 (Physical Access Control)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.7.1 (Physical security perimeters), A.7.5 (Securing physical premises)
implementation_examples: Define and enforce physical-operating-environment requirements (e.g., server room access, environmental monitoring, location-of-data policy) consistent with the sensitivity of the data and applicable regulation
Audit physical protection at the same cadence as other controls
Include third-party data centres in the scope where applicable
assessment_objectives: Determine whether physical operating-environment requirements are documented
Determine whether the requirements reflect data sensitivity and regulation
Determine whether compliance is audited on a cadence
Determine whether third-party facilities are covered
